items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I loved him because we were such good friends

ctx.x: I've heard of him. I just wondered where I'd heard of him. I think Johnny Hyman or whatever you want to call him mentioned him.

They knew each other. Johnny knew him very well because he mentioned him many times. I knew Johnny Hyman since 1926. Johnny Wiggs. That's Johnny Wiggs. Same person. The name you've seen him, right? He said something mighty nice for me the last time I ever heard of him, and this was in the second line. The last write-up that he got. I don't know if you saw it, but anyway, he was talking about the different musicians that he'd played with, and when he got down to me, he said, oh, Professor Jeff Riddick, the old…
There was no, there was a private service, you know. Yeah. His family was strange about that. They didn't want anybody to know.
